name: data-pilot-vscode
description: Find, understand, and prepare test datasets without loading everything into memory.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces Data Pilot allows explicit open, metadata, preview, and value inspection only. Edit, export, global scans, and agent operations are blocked.

dataPilot.allowExport.description: Allow exporting query results (trusted workspaces only).

dataPilot.allowEdit.description: Allow editing small fixtures (trusted workspaces only).

dataPilot.rssLimitMb.description: Soft RSS limit (MiB) for the engine child process before terminate/recover.

scripts.package: npm run compile && mkdir -p ../../tmp && npx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o ../../tmp/data-pilot.vsix
scripts.test: node -e "console.log('extension tests covered by @data-pilot/core trust suite')"
